name: RobotState
meaning: u8 Robot+0x2d8. States 0-2 are passive (state-flag 8 clear); the rest run the driven switch in Robot_Update (jump table 0x460b27, index state-3).

name: ROBOT_ST_DORMANT
meaning: anim 9; no ALWAYS_UPDATE, no gravity; a rider (move modifier) wakes it to 1

name: ROBOT_ST_IDLE
meaning: anim 9; gravity via FallStep; settles to 0 when landed, untouched, riderless and smoke gone

name: ROBOT_ST_CARRIED
meaning: anim 1 loop; carried by Ralph (msg 4); NO_BOX_COLLIDE

name: ROBOT_ST_DASH
meaning: anim 0x12; sfx 0x98; 600 u/s; smoke; at least 0x400 ticks, continues while run held

name: ROBOT_ST_DIE
meaning: anim 0xA; msg 0 arg 0 from anything but FireBall/Sam-with-traj

name: ROBOT_ST_DIE_BURN_DROWN
meaning: anim 0x15; FireBall kill, death box or water

name: ROBOT_ST_EJECT_FLIGHT
meaning: anim 0x18 loop; 2 s scripted parabola, eject camera

name: ROBOT_ST_EJECT_LAND
meaning: table anim 0x19 (never started); → 7 if controllable else 1

name: ROBOT_ST_LAUNCHED
meaning: anim 0xA; msg 0xC; no update code, exits via msg 0xB/0x25

name: ROBOT_ST_TRAPPED_STRUGGLE
meaning: anim 4; entered on msg 0x40 (each Action press relayed by the WolfTrap)

name: ROBOT_ST_ACTIVATE
meaning: anim 0xD; ctx 3 (e.g. Mailbox), sends msg 1 at anim end
